unit.why: A brief anecdote: the Seer of Lublin praises a man to his face, sees his face change, and remarks that he lacks equanimity. The grandson then explains the remark, so the anecdote sits inside a teaching on hishtavut.

stories.start_quote: כמו ששמעתי ממו״ר אא"ק מהרי"י מלובלין
stories.summary_en: The Seer of Lublin tested a man by praising him to his face; seeing the man's face change, he said the man had not yet reached equanimity, and R. Moshe of Sambor explains that true equanimity means seeing oneself as nothing, untouched by praise or blame.
